snippet.description:

In this quick EV update, I take a look at the site and show the latest progress as the new Tesla charging equipment is being installed. The site is still fenced off and not yet open at the time of recording, but it looks like Basingstoke could soon have a useful new Tesla Supercharger location.
If these are V4 Superchargers, this could be good news not just for Tesla owners, but potentially for non-Tesla EV drivers too, thanks to the longer cable design and wider compatibility where Tesla opens sites to other EVs.
This location could be especially useful for drivers travelling around Basingstoke, Hampshire, the M3 corridor, or anyone needing reliable rapid charging in the area.

snippet.title: Create a Basement Office | This First House
snippet.description:
Project coordinator Camille Dettmore talks through some important considerations with her client about their budget-friendly home office.

SUBSCRIBE to This Old House: http://bit.ly/SubscribeThisOldHouse.

You might think that turning a basement into a functional office space would cost big bucks, but that doesn’t have to be the case. With our homeowners planning to use their basement as an interim office before tackling a full office and bedroom renovation, project coordinator Camille Dettmore knew she had to keep the office affordable and not make any extra work down the road.

Be Mindful of Where You’re Spending
During a project like this, it’s important not to spend on materials, labor, or finishes that you’ll have to change or rip out later. An interim office should meet the minimum requirements to make it comfortable, functional, and professional.

Paint Makes a Huge Difference
Painting the basement can make a huge difference without blowing the budget. Painting the ceiling a dark, matte color like black or dark gray will help hide imperfections, blend the mechanicals in with the surroundings, and create a clean look. Painting the walls with a waterproof paint will help control the moisture levels and also give the basement a fresher, brighter look.

Affordable, Waterproof Flooring
Many homeowners choose to go with floating floors for a project like this, but they’ll need to be ripped out for framing down the road. Instead, consider a waterproof, resilient flooring like epoxy. Epoxy is affordable, easy to install, and it can be framed over. Just be sure to choose a low VOC product to prevent harsh odors.

Balance Function, Future, and Budget
Just because you’re not ready to tackle a full-fledged project now doesn’t mean something like an interim basement office is out of the question. If you balance the space’s functionality with your future plans and smart budgeting, a basement can be the perfect place for a work-from-home office space.

snippet.title: Most EV Charger Installations Are WRONG! #electrician #electrical #ev
snippet.description:
EV charger installations get done wrong way more often than people realize. As a licensed electrician, I see mistakes all the time that can lead to failed inspections, overloaded panels, tripped breakers, and even dangerous wiring conditions. In this short, I’m showing one of the most common EV charger installation issues I run into and why it matters if you’re installing a Tesla charger, ChargePoint, or Emporia EV charger at your home.

A lot of homeowners think installing an EV charger is simple, but once you factor in electrical load calculations, breaker sizing, continuous load requirements, and panel capacity, things get complicated fast. If your electrical system isn’t set up correctly, you can end up with overheating wires, nuisance breaker trips, or a charger that never performs the way it should.

This clip comes from my full Master Electrician POV episode where I walk through real-world EV charger installations and explain what electricians look for when installing Level 2 charging at a home. I cover Tesla Universal Wall Connectors, Emporia Pro chargers, and ChargePoint Home Flex installs, and explain when a panel upgrade is required and when it’s not.

If you’re thinking about installing an EV charger, upgrading your electrical panel, or just want to understand how EV charging actually works from a professional electrician’s perspective, check out the full video on my channel.
